plugins.name: Hello World
plugins.description: Minimal example plugin that logs lifecycle events and demonstrates config, storage and scheduling.
plugins.author: Michael André Reber

plugins.name: Emby Watch-State Migration
plugins.description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions per user from an Emby server into Matinee.
plugins.author: Anna Reber

plugins.name: Plex Watch-State Migration
plugins.description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions per user from a Plex server into Matinee. The owner and Plex Home users migrate fully. External shared accounts migrate watched flags from the server history.
plugins.author: Anna Reber

plugins.name: Spotify Playlist Sync
plugins.description: Sync your Spotify playlists into Matinee. Tracks are matched against your music libraries, songs you don't have appear as greyed-out 'not available' entries.
plugins.author: Michael André Reber

plugins.name: LDAP Single Sign-on
plugins.description: Sign users in against an LDAP directory such as Active Directory or FreeIPA. Directory users get a Matinee account on first sign-in, and an existing local account of the same name is linked to its directory identity.
plugins.author: Michael André Reber

plugins.name: OpenID Connect Single Sign-on
plugins.description: Sign users in through an OpenID Connect identity provider such as Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia or Entra ID. Users get a Matinee account on first sign-in, and an existing local account of the same username is linked to its identity.
plugins.author: Michael André Reber
